candidates.description: The percentage of tumor nuclei expressing the Ki-67 protein, used as a marker for cellular proliferation.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Extract the percentage value associated with Ki-67 or MIB-1 in the pathology report's immunohistochemistry (IHC) section.
candidates.measurement_definition: The percentage of tumor cells showing nuclear positivity for Ki-67 (MIB-1) as determined by immunohistochemistry.
candidates.name: Ki-67 Proliferative Index
candidates.uncertainty: It is uncertain whether the percentage is based on a manual count or automated imaging analysis.

citations.quote: ECOG 0 – fully active, asymptomatic aside from respiratory symptoms

candidates.description: A scale measuring a patient's level of functioning and ability to carry out daily activities.
candidates.extraction_instruction: Locate the mention of 'ECOG' or 'Performance status' and extract the corresponding numeric grade (0-4).
candidates.measurement_definition: The patient's status according to the Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) scale.
candidates.name: ECOG Performance Status
candidates.uncertainty: The specific criteria for the grade assignment are not fully detailed in the excerpts.

limitations: Small number of patients provided in the evidence.
Lack of diversity in molecular mutations across the provided samples.
summary: The evidence identifies baseline clinical variables used in the assessment of non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) patients, specifically focusing on tumor proliferative markers and functional status.
